verdict.rationale: Stripe publishes an official Model Context Protocol server (docs.stripe.com/mcp) letting AI agents call the Stripe API and search its knowledge base, corroborated by a docs probe and multiple doc citations, plus an agent-skills GitHub repo for MCP-based integration. missing for 10: independent hands-on/community verification of the MCP server working in practice (only first-party docs/probe evidence, no third-party confirmation).
